scope: Targeted, non-exhaustive follow-up across security, SE/PL and AI/NLP venues and preprints. Literature and metadata only; no new experiments, production changes, model calls or historical run mutations.
date_policy: arXiv dates are UTC unless explicitly converted. Venue confirmation date is not announcement date. Older omissions, version updates and first submissions are separate.
limitations: Primary paper/institution/author/venue sources used for factual claims; mirrors were discovery-only.
Official acceptance, author-declared acceptance, under-review and challenge-topic statuses are distinct.
Available source URLs do not establish runnable artifacts or independently reproduced results.
No additional verified direct first-publication entries in a targeted venue search is not evidence of their absence.
Some source pages and official individual listings were inaccessible; these gaps are explicit per entry.
